svg.text: Tessera screen at default width: what it previews
C is recommended: the song on top follows the PLAYS switch (timeline, or the clip grid), and the selected track's notes play underneath.
The timeline, larger. Says “arranger” but not “piano roll”.
The selected track as a piano roll. Hides the rest of the song.
Clips as tiles on the timeline; notes light up under the playhead.
Same screen; the top half becomes the clip grid. The framed column is the scene LAUNCH starts.
